profile.headline: Software Engineer & Front-End Lead @ Crocodile Labs
profile.summary: I'm a full-stack developer with an interest in writing impeccably clean code and extensive documentation.  The professional and social advancement of trans and queer women is my passion.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Front-end lead primarily responsible for building/maintaining the Ambient Finance platform
• Set standards for code quality and app architecture
* Perform code reviews and oversee merges into the central development pipeline
• Interview and onboard new devs working on the Ambient Finance codebase

positions.title: Internet Marketing Manager
positions.description:
• Oversaw generation and handling of up to 1,500 unique sales leads per month.
• Performed monthly CRM audits raising gross sales and closing ratios up to 200%.
• Coordinated 20+ interconnected SaaS platforms for lead generation, prospect engagement.
• Managed a tech budget of $70,000/mn and generated original reporting to show efficacy.

positions.title: Sales Consultant
positions.description: Automotive sales for the Galeana Automotive Group.  Sold products from the Kia, Chrysler, and Jeep model inventory.

positions.title: Sales Specialist
positions.description:
• Managed a book of business of up to 70 clients representing $500,000 in annual revenue.
• Received 18 Home Awards for achievement in my role and multiple written commendations.
• Captain of the inFocus store safety team and leader of the inventory audit prep team.

honors.title: Platinum Homer Award
honors.description: I received my Platinum Homer Award in the summer of 2016, recognizing receipt of my 12th Homer Award for excellence in my position since joining the company.  On leaving the company in April 2017, I've received 18 awards in an aggregate 33 months of employment.

honors.title: Recognition of Excellence - Biology
honors.description: Recognition for performance on the Praxis II Biology scoring in the top 15% of scores in the history of the administration of the exam.

projects.title: Ambient Finance
projects.description: Ambient Finance (https://ambient.finance/) is a front-end UI which serves as a portal for users to interact with the CrocSwap smart contract, a DeFi protocol running on the Ethereum virtual machine.

testScores.name: GRE General
testScores.description:
Verbal: 680/800 (96th percentile)
Quantitative: 770/800 (87th percentile)
Writing: 6/6 (99th percentile)
